'''SyntheTech''' was a manufacturing company. It produced equipment for [[Droid/Legends|droids]], such as the [[AA-1 VerboBrain/Legends|AA-1 VerboBrain]]<ref name="SWS" /> and the [[AAA-2 VerboBrain]].
